entries.source: Keeps menu, dialogue and HUD textures crisp independently of 3D scene filtering.
For high-resolution gameplay, keep Original Pixel Resolution off and Crisp Interface on. Original Pixel Resolution lowers the entire scene to phone resolution.
Invert weapon / equipment menu Up and Down
Reverses vertical selection only in the inventory. Applies to keyboard, D-pad and left stick; movement and other menus are unchanged.
